mapper.sql: cs.id, cs.course_id, cs.semester_id, cs.classroom_id, cs.day_of_week, cs.start_section, cs.end_section, cs.start_week, cs.end_week, cs.week_type, cs.create_time, cs.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , c.course_name AS courseName, cr.room_no AS roomNo, cr.building AS building FROM course_schedule cs LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = cs.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON cr.id = cs.classroom_id AND cr.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cs.day_of_week, cs.start_section

SELECT , c.course_code AS courseCode, c.course_name AS courseName FROM course_schedule cs INNER JOIN course_selection sel ON sel.course_id = cs.course_id AND sel.student_id = #{studentId} AND sel.status = 1 AND sel.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = cs.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.semester_id = #{semesterId} ORDER BY cs.day_of_week, cs.start_section
